messages:
irene: Heads up — we're seeing gRPC streaming stalls between gpu-worker pools (us-west2a -> us-west2b). Multiple jobs report 'stream reset' and long pauses, esp for long-running token streams. Noticed this after last night's node reprovisioning.

sam: yep I have alerts too, retransmit counters up on a few nodes. traces show long pauses during token fetch, then the stream resumes. no obvious OOM or CPU spikes.

kevin: what does `kubectl logs` show for the sidecar? Any TCP retransmits or socket errors?

irene: sidecar logs show repeated `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = stream reset` and client reconnects. On the node kernel there are lots of `IP: fragmented packet received, dropping` messages.

luca: that smells like MTU mismatch + PMTU discovery failing. Did anything change to the CNI or network stack during reprovision?

irene: nodes were reprovisioned with a second, low-MTU mgmt NIC for out-of-band. Primary NIC is 9000 (jumbo), mgmt NIC is 1500. SR-IOV VFs were attached for GPU traffic to the jumbo path, but some traffic is getting routed out the mgmt NIC (VXLAN overlay).

sam: can you paste `ip link` and `ethtool -k` from the affected node?

irene: sure — snippet below (redacted):

```
2: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc fq_codel state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether aa:bb:cc:dd ee ff brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
3: eth1: mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 11:22:33:44:55 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
vf0@eth0: mtu 9000
vf1@eth1: mtu 1500
```

and tcpdump on the node egress showed large segmented frames (~8500) being emitted but then `ICMP fragmentation needed` never hits the app, and kernel logs show reassembly failures.

devops-bot: Note: ICMP unreachable/fragmentation messages suppressed by default on our cloud firewall. See runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/mtu-pmtu

kevin: that combination is rough: jumbo on one path, non-jumbo on another + ICMP blocked => PMTU discovery can't negotiate smaller packet size. GSO/GRO will stack up big frames and remote will drop fragments. gRPC's streaming (persistent TCP) suffers badly.

maria: quick test suggestions: 1) temporarily force container/netns MTU to 1500 2) disable GSO on the VF that's sending out-of-path 3) clamp PMTU on egress vxlan/eni via `ip link set dev vxlan0 mtu 1500` — any of those should reduce fragmentation.

luca: also check `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc` and `net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects` — but we prefer fixing MTU consistency rather than changing global PMTU settings.

irene: applied a quick fix on one node: `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500` and `ethtool -K eth0 gso off gro off tso off` on the VF. Streaming recovered immediately for pods pinned to that node.

sam: confirmed — metrics for that node show gRPC latency back to baseline and retransmits down. Good repro.

kevin: we should roll a daemonset to enforce MTU on the data path interfaces and disable GSO/TCP offload on the VFs until we get consistent hardware config in provisioning. Also need to update Terraform so new nodes have consistent NIC MTU and SR-IOV config.

maria: I'll open a PR for a node init daemonset + a reconciliation controller to enforce: set host data NIC MTU to X, set vxlan MTU to X, and toggle offload flags on VFs if path MTU != jumbo. Also add a prom rule: `node_network_fragmentation_errors > 0` to page if reassembly drops spike.

kevin: created infra ticket INFRA-7421 and PR #432 to push the DS & Terraform change. tagging networking for review.

luca: long term we should: 1) whitelist ICMP fragmentation messages in cloud firewall or mirror them to a collector, 2) ensure single MTU domain per data path, 3) avoid mixing jumbo and non-jumbo for service-facing overlays.

irene: noted. For the short term I'll roll the DS to the affected us-west2 clusters and monitor. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam: can we add a short runbook step to check for dual-NIC MTU mismatch during post-provision smoke tests? saves debugging time.

maria: added to runbook and PR includes a smoke test that pings with DF set and validates PMTU negotiation.

irene: rolling now to both AZs. will update when stable.

kevin: FYI, I'm scheduling a follow-up to decide default MTU values for our GPU SKUs and to standardize SR-IOV provisioning.

luca: thanks — great catch.

irene: update 30m later — roll went fine, no further stream stalls observed on affected jobs. closing the immediate incident, will keep INFRA-7421 open until Terraform changes land.

maria: PR merged to staging, will promote after canary tomorrow. :rocket:
